model:
rachana: 1
sutra: scenario-pv
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: scenario-pv, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Market risk · Scenario PVs", id: "$.SCENARIO_PV_ID", with: "nonblank($.POSITION_ID, $.TRADE_ID)" }
strip:
  - { label: "Position", bind: "link($.POSITION_ID, 'position')" }
  - { label: "Trade", bind: "link($.TRADE_ID, 'trade')" }
  - { label: "Currency", bind: "$.CURRENCY" }
  - { label: "Base PV", bind: "$.BASE_PV", fmt: "amount0", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Scenario set", bind: "link($.SCENARIO_SET_ID, 'scenario-set')" }
  - { label: "Business date", bind: "$.BUSINESS_DATE" }
panels:
  - id: pnl-chart
    kind: line
    title: "P&L under each scenario day (PV minus base PV, in the position's currency)"
    key: "F2"
    code: "PNL"
    values: "map($.SCENARIO_PV, @ - $.BASE_PV)"
    labels: "$src.SCENARIO_DATES"
  - id: pv-chart
    kind: line
    title: "PV under each scenario day (in the position's currency)"
    code: "PV"
    values: "$.SCENARIO_PV"
    labels: "$src.SCENARIO_DATES"
  - id: scenarios
    kind: table
    title: "PV and P&L by scenario day"
    key: "F3"
    code: "DAYS"
    rows: "$.SCENARIO_PV"
    limit: 30
    empty: "No scenario PVs"
    columns:
      - { label: "Index i", bind: "#index" }
      - { label: "Scenario day", bind: "$src.SCENARIO_DATES[#index]" }
      - { label: "PV", bind: "@", fmt: "amount0" }
      - { label: "P&L (PV - base PV)", bind: "@ - $.BASE_PV", fmt: "signed0", tone: "sign" }
  - id: note
    kind: markdown
    title: "How to read it"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
    text: "Index i is the position of the value in SCENARIO_PV and of the day in the scenario set ${$.SCENARIO_SET_ID}. P&L here is in ${$.CURRENCY}, before the FX scenario of the currency turns it into USD."
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
    phone: { tier: "more", from: "fragment" }
keys: { F7: "link($.SCENARIO_SET_ID, 'scenario-set')", F9: "raw" }
